This transaction represents the automatic surrender of shares to the issuer upon vesting of restricted shares units to satisfy the reporting person's tax withholding obligations.

These securities are restricted stock units ("RSUs"). Each RSU represents a contingent right to receive one share of Class A common stock. 1/4th of the RSUs shall vest on February 20, 2027 and 1/4th of the RSUs shall vest on each three-month anniversary thereafter, subject to the Reporting Person continuing to be a service provider through each such date. || Certain of these securities are represented by RSUs.
